movieTitle: Bạo Chúa Dung Nham và Thủy Quái Lôi Đình
loglineVi: Giữa Thung lũng Nham thạch Kreta, Bạo Chúa Dung Nham phải giữ lấy nguồn nước cuối cùng trước Thủy Quái Lôi Đình đang đói khát — và ở khoảnh khắc chiến thắng, nhận ra sức mạnh thật sự nằm ở lòng khoan dung.

characters.lookEn: a stocky young tyrannosaurus standing upright on two hind legs with tiny arms tucked to the chest with charcoal-grey pebbly skin, a broad expressive snout, big amber eyes, a nicked brow scar and bright ember-orange stripes down the back as a signature accent
characters.voiceEn: deep chesty growls and proud huffs
characters.personalityVi:
• Chỉ số hình thể: Cao 6 m, dài 12 m, nặng khoảng 8 tấn; đầu to, mõm rộng biểu cảm, tay trước ngắn hai ngón, chân sau to khỏe, đuôi dày; da xám than sần với sọc cam rực dọc lưng, vết sẹo nhỏ trên chân mày.
• Tính cách & Linh hồn cảm xúc: Kiêu hãnh, nóng nảy nhưng giàu lòng trắc ẩn; giấu nỗi sợ mất mái nhà sau tiếng gầm, càng bị dồn ép càng bùng lên ý chí.
• Hành động & Chiêu thức đặc trưng:
  - [ACTION_WARNING_ROAR]: Dậm chân và gầm cảnh cáo để bảo vệ lãnh thổ.
  - [SKILL_1_HEADBUTT_CHARGE]: Cúi đầu lao tới húc trán cực mạnh vào ngực đối thủ.
  - [SKILL_2_STOMP_QUAKE]: Dậm chân thật mạnh làm mặt đất rung chuyển khiến đối thủ mất thăng bằng.

characters.lookEn: a sleek spinosaurus with a level horizontal back and long balancing tail, slate-blue crocodile-like skin, a long narrow snout with a sly smile, sharp green eyes and a huge fan-shaped sail with bold teal stripes as a signature accent
characters.personalityVi:
• Chỉ số hình thể: Cao 5 m tính cả buồm lưng, dài 14 m, nặng khoảng 7 tấn; thân thon dài, mõm hẹp như cá sấu, vuốt trước cong, buồm lưng cao; da xanh xám đá phiến với sọc xanh ngọc trên buồm.
• Tính cách & Linh hồn cảm xúc: Xảo quyệt, kiên nhẫn, đói khát nhưng biết tôn trọng kẻ mạnh hơn mình.
• Hành động & Chiêu thức đặc trưng:
  - [ACTION_REED_AMBUSH]: Ẩn mình trong lau sậy rồi trồi lên bất ngờ.
  - [SKILL_1_SNAP_LUNGE]: Lao tới đớp nhanh bằng chiếc mõm dài.
  - [SKILL_2_TAIL_SWEEP]: Xoay người quật đuôi quét ngã đối thủ.

environment.lookEn: a wide volcanic valley of dark basalt ridges and warm steaming pools, with sparse ferns on the rocks and a slow lava river glowing far in the background
environment.lightingEn: a low golden sun from the right raking across the rocks
environment.paletteEn: warm amber and dusty rust tones with a small teal accent

shots.gazeEn: looking down at the last warm pool
shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Ember stands small on a ridge above the last warm pool, the valley stretching out below
shots.actionEn: Ember stops at the edge of the ridge and spots the last warm pool below
shots.actingBeatEn: tired drooping shoulders lift as hope returns to the eyes
shots.endStateEn: Ember stands at the edge of the ridge with tired shoulders lifted and hopeful eyes fixed on the pool below

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Ember lowers a broad snout to the water, eyes half closed with relief
shots.actionEn: Ember laps the water, then freezes mid-sip
shots.actingBeatEn: relief turns into sharp alert suspicion, brows tightening
shots.endStateEn: Ember frozen mid-sip with eyes turned sideways in sharp suspicion, brows tightened, water dripping from the chin

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: over the shoulder of Ember, whose single rounded striped head and back fill the left foreground softly blurred, Tide's head and long needle-thin crocodile snout rise out of the tall reeds in three-quarter profile facing screen-left, sly narrowed eyes
shots.actionEn: Tide rises slowly a little higher out of the reeds
shots.actingBeatEn: sly narrowed eyes and a slow closed-mouth smirk
shots.endStateEn: Tide has risen a little higher in the same reeds with more of the sail showing and a sly closed-mouth smirk, long crocodile snout in three-quarter profile, while Ember's striped back stays in the left foreground exactly as in image 1

shots.sfxEn: a heavy foot stamp and pebbles skittering
shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Ember straightens to full height, chest puffed out, water dripping from the jaw
shots.actionEn: Ember stamps one foot and lets out a warning roar
shots.actingBeatEn: surprise hardens into a fierce, protective glare
shots.endStateEn: Ember mid-roar with the mouth wide open and a fierce protective glare, the head and chest still filling the frame exactly as in image 1

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: side-view close-up of Tide facing screen-left at the pool edge, the head pulled back with the long crocodile jaws wide open
shots.actionEn: Tide's long jaws snap shut with a sharp clack
shots.actingBeatEn: the eyes narrow in annoyance after the miss
shots.endStateEn: the same side-view close-up, Tide's long jaws snapped shut and the eyes narrowed in annoyance

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: close-up of Ember facing screen-right at the pool edge, eyes wide and looking up, mouth firmly closed
shots.actionEn: Ember ducks low just in time
shots.actingBeatEn: wide shocked eyes, mouth firmly closed
shots.endStateEn: the same close-up, Ember ducked low with the head pulled down between the shoulders, wide shocked eyes, mouth firmly closed

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Tide with water streaming off the snout, eyes narrowed
shots.actionEn: Tide shakes the water off and licks the teeth
shots.actingBeatEn: annoyance turns into a cunning, confident smile
shots.endStateEn: Tide with a cunning confident smile, water droplets flying off the long snout

shots.sfxEn: a whoosh and a wet slap
shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: low close-up of the wet mud shore with only the tip of Tide's long blue-grey tail entering low from the right edge of frame
shots.actionEn: Tide's tail sweeps fast across the mud from right to left
shots.endStateEn: the same low close-up of the mud shore where only the long blue-grey tail is visible, now swept across to the left side of frame low over the mud with a spray of mud droplets, the rest of the body out of frame to the right

shots.sfxEn: a heavy wet thud of a body landing in mud
shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Ember alone in mid-air falling backward above the shallow mud at the shore, round shocked mouth, legs up
shots.actionEn: Ember lands flat on the back in the shallow mud
shots.endStateEn: Ember lying flat on the back in the shallow mud with legs in the air and a frozen shocked face, a small mud splash

shots.vocalEn: a shaky breath that turns into a low growl
shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Ember's half-open eye with mud on the eyelid, the face pressed sideways in the mud
shots.actionEn: Ember's eye snaps into focus at the sound of approaching footsteps
shots.actingBeatEn: fear in the eye hardens into stubborn determination
shots.endStateEn: Ember's eye wide open and narrowed with stubborn determination

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: side view along the mud shore, Ember on the left third facing right with the head lowered, starting to charge
shots.actionEn: Ember charges from left to right along the shore with the head lowered
shots.endStateEn: side view, Ember near the right edge of frame mid-charge with the head lowered and fierce focused eyes

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: Tide staggering backward, dazed, eyes unfocused
shots.actionEn: Tide stumbles back, blinks hard and shakes the head
shots.endStateEn: Tide blinking with the head tilted, dazed, eyes softening into wary respect

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: extreme close-up of Ember's eye and brow with mud on the brow, the eye narrowed in fury and the brow pulled down hard
shots.endStateEn: the same extreme close-up, the brow lifts and softens and the eye opens round, kind and calm

shots.ambientEn: low wind, bubbling hot springs and a distant rumble
shots.startStateEn: muddy tired Ember standing on two hind legs at the edge of the warm pool, bending at the hips to drink with tiny arms tucked, mud specks on the body
shots.actionEn: Ember drinks, then lifts the head with quiet pride
shots.actingBeatEn: exhaustion eases into a small proud closed-mouth smile
shots.endStateEn: Ember raises the head from the water with eyes half closed and a small proud closed-mouth smile, a few droplets on the chin
